content.title: 2026 Masters schedule: TV times, channel, streaming, dates and more
content.text: Find out how to watch the 2026 Masters on TV and streaming online below. Courtesy The Masters on X.com The 2026 Masters is almost here. In a matter of days, the world’s best pro golfers will be at Augusta National Golf Club for the first major of the year. Here’s everything you need to know about the 2026 Masters schedule, including online streaming details, TV times and more.How to watch the 2026 MastersSpring has arrived and the calendar has turned to April, which means one thing for golf fans the world over: it’s time for the Masters.For the first time in 2026, the best players from the PGA Tour, DP World Tour and LIV Golf are ready to compete in the same field and fight for Masters history from Thursday, April 9, through Sunday, April 12.Storylines abound heading into Masters week. World No. 1 and two-time Masters champion Scottie Scheffler is again the betting favorite in 2026. But he has a few star players challenging him for that position.Rory McIlroy is one of them. The veteran pro finally won his first green jacket last year in dramatic fashion, completing the career Grand Slam in the process. McIlroy hasn’t looked as sharp early this year as he did in the lead-up to last year’s Masters. He’s also dealing with a back injury.Bryson DeChambeau, LIV Golf’s biggest star, is in fine form as he goes for his first green jacket. He’s won the last two LIV events.They’ll have to deal with a host of other pros who are playing well heading into Augusta, including past Masters winners Jordan Spieth and Jon Rahm.2026 Masters TV coverage will be shared between ESPN and CBS, with ESPN airing the first two rounds on Thursday and Friday, and CBS broadcasting the third and final rounds on the weekend. For the first time this year, Amazon Prime Video will provide exclusive early coverage of Rounds 1 and 2. Paramount+ will stream early coverage of Rounds 3 and 4 on the weekend.Streaming coverage of the 2026 Masters will be available online via Masters.com, the Masters app, Masters YouTube page, the ESPN App, DirecTV, Amazon Prime Video and Paramount+. You can watch simulcasts and featured group coverage during all four rounds on Masters.com and the Masters App, which will also feature scoring, interactive player tracking and “Every Shot, Every Hole” and “My Group.”You can check out the complete TV and streaming schedules for the 2026 Masters below.2026 Masters TV schedule (ET)Wednesday, April 8 (Par 3 Contest): 2-4 p.m. (ESPN)Thursday,
